title: P-preauth3: target_role index checked at authorization
description: room-policy-04 §4 PreAuthRoleEntry.target_role: first_match returns target_role.role_index (decision mimid-1wgh.3.16) without checking it exists in roles_list or is not 0/1. Consistent with mimid-1wgh.3.40, the check that the index names a defined, usable role belongs to authorization (.3.9), which has roles_list.
